liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (4 reviews): Reviewer says this Dark Star has a texture like the inside of an electronic pinball machine; Reviewer recalls, uncertainly, that parts of this Dark Star ended up on Infrared Roses [17][18][19][20]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Garcia's MIDI-guitar tone during Not Fade Away is singled out as some of the best the reviewer has heard [21]
- **Blow Away** (1 review): Brent sounded manic at the end of Blow Away, firing up both the crowd and himself [23]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd89-10-26 s1t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-26 s1t02 Foolish Heart**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-26 s1t03 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-26 s1t04 Stagger Lee**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-26 s1t05 Me & My Uncle**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-26 s1t06 Big River**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-26 s1t07 Brown Eyed Women**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]
- **gd89-10-26 s1t08 Victim Or The Crime**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [29]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-10-26.142607.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 167 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1989-10-26.147766.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 161 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1989-10-26.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83428.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 162 min; rated 3.88/5 by 17 [4]
- **gd89-10-26.set2.dsbd.miller.18664.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 101 min; rated 4.49/5 by 63 [14]. Said about its sound: Soundboard mix puts vocals forward; Jerry's guitar is relatively quiet [24]

## Around the show

- Attendee says a rumor held this was the band's 2000th live performance [22]
- Parking lot in a crossover neighborhood was wild and uncontained, with many police around afterward, but no bad reports [22]
- Attendee went to the Rascal House after the show for matzoh ball soup at 1am [22]
- Attendee found the first set's songs dwelling on death and destruction, other than the opener Foolish Heart [26]
- Attendee remembers people frantically leaving, unnerved by the band's eerie playing [26]
- Reviewer finds an ominous undertow in the performance; a sister called the tape a bit scary [27]
- Reviewer ties this show with 9/18/87 as their favorite show of the late 1980s [21]
- Attendee calls it the best show of 1989 [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-10-26.142607.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk4.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master (FOB)Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK4 mics @ 110 degrees, ORTF, Schoeps t-bar, hand held, chin high > Monster… [1]
- **gd1989-10-26.147766.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [3]. Also: Charlie Miller handled all transfers and mastering; this set is 16-bit at 44.1; Tape flips in Dark Star and Not Fade Away were patched using Vault DAT [3]
- **gd1989-10-26.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83428.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) D [4]. Also: Tapes were supplied by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; Tape flips in Dark Star and Not Fade Away were patched with DSBD [4]
- **gd89-10-26.set2.dsbd.miller.18664.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard - Set 2 only [14]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1989-10-26 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1989-10-26-grateful-dead-ticket/) [30]
- Fan art by @donelichterman: [The Grateful Dead Live: October 26, 1989 – Miami Arena, Miami, FL is Don's Pick Tonight! - The Grateful Dead Live](https://thegratefuldeadlive.com/october-26-1989-miami-arena/) [31]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead 30 Trips Around The Sun 1989 Miami Arena Florida FL 10/26/89 3 CD | #4861348753](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-30-trips-around-sun-4861348753) [32]
